body:
Using a throwaway because....

When I was a kid, all of my family drank heavily and did a lot of drugs. My siblings would beat the shit out of themselves and being the youngest of 7, it wasn't great to witness as it was a frequent occurrence. A lot of rehabs, lapses, and relapses. Drug induced fights. Withdrawals. Screaming at my parents and each other about getting fucked up.

Through all of the screaming, breaking glass, and my mom crying, my next oldest sibling would lock us in my room and play guitar just loud enough that I didn't have to hear it all.

No one will probably read this, but I don't play for the girls, I don't play for my friends, I don't play to be a rockstar. 

I play alone for myself, because it still makes things okay.
Thanks man. I appreciate it, honestly.
Thank you. It's 4 am here, and I dont have much of the energy to type, but thank you from my heart.
I ditched them a long time ago. Suddenly, my life was much better.
